narration.text: A reseller's EU listings brought up to the product-safety rule on two marketplaces before they are hidden: a maker's address added, three Union responsible persons named from the mail, a missing model and the warnings the products carry, while food, an antique, seeds, listings not offered in the EU, listings already complete and a throw that needs no warning are left alone. This is a chore for the owner of a small reseller of homeware, who sells other makers' goods to EU buyers on two marketplaces, both of which will hide non-compliant EU listings on 1 November. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 7,100 dollars of the 7,100 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 68 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
